claim: The playbook recommends host-authoritative state sync with network-driven puppets for remote players as the default for closed native single-player games, and rejects lockstep unless the engine is already deterministic.
evidence: how-coop-mods-work 1.6: retrofits onto closed games 'are almost always host-authoritative state sync'; 1.1 puppet pattern; 1.2 'Copy results, not events'.
verification_method: Read-only reading of the shallow clone (depth 50) at the stated commit; no code built or run.
limitations: Guidance is drawn from other games' mods (Gothic 3, OOT, TES3MP, Skyrim Together); applicability to Shadow of War is a HYPOTHESIS.
next_experiment: Write a Project Mordor ADR choosing host-authoritative state sync; list which Shadow of War systems need results-only replication (deaths, loot, Nemesis outcomes).
